izor.details: 14 requests: 8 JSON successes, 6 HTTP 403. Earlier independent 2050 request succeeded. Do not retry denied requests. profil.id can identify a shared beach profile (2049/2047 -> 2050, 2044 -> 2043); it is NOT proven to identify the sample station. Resolve semantics before matching. Samples are in isp; historical annual/multiyear summaries in povg/povk must stay separate. No stable public API contract, rate limits or reuse license verified.

dhmz.evidence: 15.09.2026, Split row 24.0 at column 08. XML carries station names but no coordinates or timezone; no per-beach binding. Blank Termin is missing, never zero. Mljet-Malo jezero must not be assumed to be open Adriatic sea.
dhmz.capStatus: Actual; regional mapping and warning coverage unresolved, no local all-clear inferred.
